'''Luiss Nevs''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sluissi]] and member of the [[Sluis Van Congregate]]. [[Dirk Harkness]] spent several days meeting with Nevs trying to persuade him to side with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] over the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Nevs explained that the Sluissi were caught in a dilemma as the Empire was their primary customer and accounted for ninety percent of the [[Sluis Van Shipyards]] business.
